reviews.name: Mayra
reviews.text: Highly recommend Edel Roofing! Lupe and his crew did an amazing job replacing my roof. They were fast, professional, and finished the entire project in just a few days. The house looks great, and the yard was left completely clean. Incredible customer service!

reviews.name: Ricardo G.
reviews.text: Great Company very professional Staff! Lupe helped us out by providing great customer service and making sure we understood how everything works and how important is to have a Reputable Company Like Edel Roofing Company we are so glad and grateful how beautiful our roof looks! Thank you!!!

reviews.name: Rosa G.
reviews.text:
Eddie and his crew did stellar work. We just moved into our new home but needed some additional storage, taller toilets et.. it took them just under 2 weeks to complete the project just as promised.
We are extremely pleased with the craftsmanship. The guys were very respectful and trustworthy. They were punctual and the best thing was they worked very clean and efficiently. Thank you Edel Roofing for your excellent service! I highly recommend.

reviews.name: Hugo D.
reviews.text: Great service! They took care of an initial issue with my easing/fascia, then inspected and showed me a few other areas of concern around the edge of my roof. They came back and took care of the other issues, including new materials, caulking, painting, and cleaning everything up afterwards. The prices are very reasonable and it's hard to tell where they did the work as they matched the paint exactly. I'm very happy with their work and will call them back as needed!

reviews.name: Alison L.
reviews.text: Communication, quick service and overall experience was wonderful. Could not recommend enough!

reviews.name: Dambaru B.
reviews.text: Work on the roof was carried out professionally. It was very smooth without any issues.
